parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL.
latest_user_direction: Finish the Magmaw 10N implementation with subagents.
objective: Close the last two gaps on baseline b4-2c0ed2d8: Blood DK 30002 at 0.948 (56 DPS short) and Fire A 30006 at 0.92 with a 6.4k fixed-baiter variance, keeping 0 boss-window deaths.
hypothesis: Blood: while seized (~11 s per Mangle) Heart Strike, Icy Touch and Plague Strike were rejected forbidden_self_aura_active 136x per kill and the tank used 3 of ~7 GCDs; only Blood runes are recoverable (Death Strike needs Frost+Unholy; the native payment uses Blood before Death runes), so admitting Heart Strike while Death Strike fails its rune preflight and a Blood rune is free beyond Rune Tap's adds 0-1 Heart Strike per kill (+0-310 DPS); reserving Bone Shield for the seize (hold the ordinary recast when it would not be back in time) cuts Mangle hit/tick damage by 20%. Fire: the baiting duty costs ~5-6k DPS per kill and sits on one mage; alternating the baiter per parasite wave (wave ledger from pillar/parasite/infection liveness, 3 s quiet ends a wave, switches wait for hook duty) splits the cost so both mages land near 42-44k, above the 38,181 floor; no damage is invented.
observations: smoke-2c0ed2d8: seize 89.8-100.8 s: Death Strike 95.4 s, Rune Strike 98.0/99.7 s, Rune Tap 91.8 s; Death Strike rune-gated 1,478 of 1,854 decisions; Bone Shield cast 54.3 s (0 charges at the seize, cooldown to 114.3 s).
Fire A per batch 39.9k/36.2k/37.0k (sd 6.4k) vs Fire B 51.3k/48.5k/48.0k with the same profile; WCL Sethra 40.2k.
forbidden_changes: No invented damage, auras, cooldown resets, teleports or Z steering; only the assignment rotates and profile conditions change.
Parasites stay controlled every wave; a dead or missing alternate keeps the current baiter.
No change to Balance/Elemental files, provisioning configs, the Rune Weapon/glyph code, WCL references or the scoreboard/graph tooling.
acceptance_conditions: Declared tests pass; module_size reports no oversized file; an independent reviewer (separate subagent session, transcript-bound import-json) approves the exact diff.

A clean policy-bound build, one smoke kill, then a 5-kill scoreboard batch vs baseline b4-2c0ed2d8 judged with `scoreboard show --actor <id>` under the playbook keep rule; mechanism evidence: seized Heart Strike rejections read magmaw_mangle_seized_heart_strike_hold and a Heart Strike lands in the seat only while Death Strike is rune-gated; Bone Shield at >=3 charges at the seize; baiter rotation wave 1 30006, wave 2 30007 in the diagnostics; both mages within ~4k; parasites controlled; 0 deaths.
0 boss-window deaths and every counted kill a native clear; otherwise the failing part is reverted.
This plan does not by itself accept any actor, the encounter or the parent objective.
